description.en: Companion cordis plugin for the AstrBot dsh gateway: it polls cache/inbox for tasks and writes results to cache/outbox, and posts completion notices through the local AstrBot HTTP endpoint so the message reaches the user from their own chat account.
description.zh: 配套 AstrBot 插件的 dsh 侧 cordis 插件：轮询 cache/inbox 领取任务、把结果写回 cache/outbox，并通过本机 AstrBot 接口送出完成通知，让消息以用户自己的聊天账号到达用户。
